description: Commission of Elections - Notify the corrected names that published in Gazette Ex. No. 2061/42-8 of 09.03.2018
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Election Commission and specifically amends the names of returned members for a local authority election, as published in a previous extraordinary gazette. The content deals with electoral processes and candidate registrations, falling squarely under the Elections category (Type 7). While it involves government officials (Election Commission members), the primary focus is electoral administration rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
